books.section: The Rise of the Service Sector
Prosperity and a New World Order (1988–2000)

stem: The change shown in the photograph most directly contributed to which political development?

options.text: The Sun Belt's rise as the political center of gravity
The end of the two-party system
options.misconception: The two-party system survived deindustrialization; the parties did not disappear.

options.text: A sharp fall in voter turnout in the South
options.misconception: The South gained people and power in these decades; turnout did not collapse there.

options.text: The repeal of the Nineteenth Amendment
options.misconception: The Nineteenth Amendment, giving women the vote, was never repealed.

rationales.A: Background: as factory jobs left the Northeast and Midwest, people and power shifted to the South and West.
rationales.B: The two-party system survived deindustrialization. Background: the parties changed; they did not disappear.
rationales.C: The South gained people and power in these decades. Background: the Sun Belt grew as the Rust Belt shrank.
rationales.D: The Nineteenth Amendment, giving women the vote, was never repealed.
rationales.general:
1. Start with the empty mill: factory jobs left the Northeast and Midwest.
2. Background: people followed the jobs south and west, to the Sun Belt's defense plants and cheaper suburbs.
3. People carry political power with them — House seats followed the same road.
4. The parties did not vanish, the South did not empty, and no amendment was repealed.
Remember: jobs move first, people second, and power third.
